annotations.title: Followers of a personal LinkedIn profile

description: Follower count of the PERSONAL LinkedIn profile shared with this brand — the lifetime total and, with startDate / endDate, the new followers per day (LinkedIn’s memberFollowersCount). This is the creator / founder growth number; Company Page followers are in linkedin_page_analytics. It needs a personal profile ticked in Manage accounts (list_connector_accounts provider linkedin, then set_connector_accounts with its id to tick it) and the LinkedIn analytics authorization on the LinkedIn card — if the reply says re-authorize, say exactly that. Read-only, free.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD — include for a daily series
